WITH filtered_item AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
),
filtered_date AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-04-02' AS date) AND CAST('2001-06-01' AS date)
),
cs_filtered AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_order_number,
           cs.cs_item_sk,
           cs.cs_sales_price,
           cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
           i.i_item_id,
           d.d_date
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN filtered_item i ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    JOIN filtered_date d ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
),
sales_returns AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_order_number,
           cs.cs_item_sk,
           cs.cs_sales_price,
           cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
           cs.i_item_id,
           cs.d_date,
           COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0) AS refunded_cash
    FROM cs_filtered cs
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
           ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
          AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
)
SELECT w.w_state,
       sr.i_item_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(sr.d_date AS date) < CAST('2001-05-02' AS date)
                THEN sr.cs_sales_price - sr.refunded_cash
                ELSE 0
           END) AS sales_before,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(sr.d_date AS date) >= CAST('2001-05-02' AS date)
                THEN sr.cs_sales_price - sr.refunded_cash
                ELSE 0
           END) AS sales_after
FROM sales_returns sr
JOIN warehouse w ON sr.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
GROUP BY w.w_state, sr.i_item_id
ORDER BY w.w_state, sr.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
